parent.R50_confounded_ubuntu_result: top-two=0.684070 regret, raw=0.0 under new misleading-tag OOD; not reuse scored R50 worlds

hypothesis.main: A gradient-trained, observable action-consequence magnitude eligibility term combined with learned context-dependent public tag-role attention can suppress large-tag small-effect distractors and retain causal B gate evidence as history length and nuisance change.
hypothesis.distinct_from_parent: R49 hard retrieved the top two by public tag, zeroing out otherwise available selected physical effects; R51 uses differentiable attention on all selected public tag,selected physical-effect pairs with two context slopes and one learned magnitude coefficient.
hypothesis.attribution: A truly trainable salience coefficient must change by AdamW after receiving nonzero measured task gradient, and zeroing it must incur regret. This is learned parameter adaptation on a deliberately narrow source; not generic event discovery or causality.
hypothesis.falsifier: Either original seed misses frozen CAL/OOD, lacks salience gradients/ablation effect, or fails source-only negative controls => R51 DEV NO-GO, without tuning spent data. Even if DEV PASS, if hand-coded absolute-effect top-two heuristic matches or dominates, learned-event-discovery superiority over strongest simple control is NOT demonstrated.

source.confound_placement: FIT: confounders in alternating groups 0,2,4,... for train AND heldout; CAL/OOD: both confounders in all groups. All positions SHA256(salt/panel/group/local step) sorted, 4 distinct; no private positions enter input.
source.observed_B_record: Use r49.r33.b._record(public_tag,action=t%2,after=public_tag+physical_selected_delta,public_context). Zero only effect[4], preserve real effect[0].
source.observed_early_and_fifth: R49 original 4 selected early observations and actual fifth 0.42 action=context consequence, not counterfactual. Return action has exact public key and zero effect.
source.fit_only_fifth_offset: Calibrate from selected fifth observations of 16 balanced FIT training groups ONLY; no CAL/OOD.
source.factual_return: R49's physical quartic FIT/CAL and cubic OOD, return state (.61,.73) group parity, goal 1.0, action regret using true selected after only for evaluator.
source.paired_gate_mean: All 16-dimensional public B means and selected action key means exactly agree across opposite hidden gate at fixed panel/group/context,q sign, but individual selected consequence records differ.
source.reference: Source-only hand-coded select two largest |decoded selected physical B effect| (since all true causal >.12, all others <=.03), choose higher or lower observed tag by public context, combine FIT-only selected fifth; zero errors on FIT/CAL/OOD before any scoring.

training.optimizer: AdamW; learned slope, effect salience and readout lr=.02, Native/GRU .001, weight_decay=0, gradient clipping norm1. No post-hoc adaptive updates.
training.main_attention: On all selected B records only: logits=(slope[observed_public_context] * observed_tag) + (positive_salience * 12 * absolute_selected_physical_B_delta). Softmax these logits; aggregate selected signed physical B delta; multiply FIT-centered selected fifth and a trained positive readout gain. Salience initialized at exactly zero and trained by real autograd, no fixed magnitude tag class.
training.baseline_raw: R49-style two context slopes over all B tags, no magnitude term, same data/draws/updates.
training.baseline_top_two: R49 stable top-two public tag reader, same two context slopes, same data/draws/updates.
training.baseline_magnitude: Public selected physical magnitude top-two retrieval (hand-coded fixed rule) then *trained* two context tag slopes, same data/draws/updates; not learned event discovery.
training.baseline_native: Same main learned magnitude selector plus actual R34 Native factual memory with all selected observations, trainable Native weights/fusion and zero-backbone ablation; Native-specific attribution separately qualified.
training.baseline_gru: Fully trained GRU over all selected (public tag,selected physical delta,public context) histories using same FIT factual data/updates; report capacity compute mismatch.

frozen_score.independent_scientific_gain_criterion: In addition to main two-seed pass, require OOD improvement >=.12 with positive bootstrap lower95 versus strongest fully competent 2-event |effect| hand-coded baseline and strongest input matched fully converged conventional, plus true positive Native backbone ablation for Native-specific claim. Otherwise independent SCIENTIFIC_PASS=false.
frozen_score.fail_policy: Never tune scored FIT heldout CAL or OOD after original result. Preserve exact negative outcomes. If hand-coded magnitude baseline matches model, report learned parameter/procedural success at most, not general causal intelligence.
